description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover that inventory must be stored at `skills/myfood-by/references/my-food.md` (creating the file if absent). 2. Agent registers 鸡蛋, 西兰花, 牛奶, 鸡胸肉 with their respective expiry dates into that file. 3. Agent then deletes (not comments out) the 牛奶 entry because it was marked consumed — the final inventory file must not contain 牛奶 at all. 4. Agent generates a dinner recommendation that (a) marks each ingredient sourced from inventory with the 【已有】 tag and (b) includes a standalone ⚠️ 临期提醒 section listing 鸡胸肉 since it expires in two days, using exactly the format specified in SKILL.md. 5. Recommendation is saved to dinner_recommendation.md. 6. Agent must NOT store any health or dietary restriction data anywhere — SKILL.md explicitly forbids it.
